finding.beyondRootReport: Same dynamic-typing class found by the matrix: every one of the 10 hex columns (not only the three root named) admitted NUL suffixes and ASCII-hex BLOBs; the free TEXT columns request_ref, token, install_generation_id, body and namespace_id admitted BLOBs; first_generation (migrated path) and grantGeneration admitted a non-integral REAL. Enumerated TEXT columns (record_type, platform, phase, settled_outcome) and the other INTEGER columns were already exact.

remedy.law: Every carrierFormat 3 and attempt_custody column states its storage class with typeof(). Every hex-bearing column is an exact whole TEXT value: typeof(column) = 'text' AND length(column) = N AND length(CAST(column AS BLOB)) = N AND prefix GLOB (where a prefix exists) AND substr(column, prefix + 1) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9a-f]*'. length() counts characters before any NUL and the CAST counts every byte, so they agree only for a NUL-free ASCII value; GLOB then sees the whole value.
remedy.whyUniformStorageClass: The matrix found the same defect class (dynamic typing) in integer and free-text columns; CHECKs see post-affinity values so no lawful row is refused (0 over-refusals); triggers, object names, keys and the seven-object dispatch are unchanged.
remedy.encodingAssumption: Byte lengths assume the SQLite database text encoding UTF-8 (default, fixed at creation). Under UTF-16 every hex-bearing row is refused (observed), so a wrong encoding fails closed and never widens admission.
alternativesRejected: STRICT tables: refuse BLOB-in-TEXT and REAL-in-INTEGER but not an embedded NUL; SQLite documents that pre-3.37.0 libraries cannot read a database containing a STRICT table, contradicting the selected staging in which a format-unaware core still reads historical generations (documentation-based, not measured here).
instr(CAST(column AS BLOB), x'00') = 0 alone: refuses NUL but not an equal-character-count multibyte value; the character/byte length pair refuses both.
remedy.historicalScope: carrierFormat 1 and 2 bytes stay frozen and still admit first-character-only, embedded-NUL and BLOB operation_ref values (p01d frozenCarrierFormat2HistoricalOperationRef: all ADMIT). Disclosed, not repaired: history is read under recordSchema-1 semantics, never re-admitted through the schema-3 gate, and can never satisfy a schema-3 SEAL join (F46).

limits: Reference and planned checks only (in-memory SQLite 3.50.4). No OS durability, crash, lock, process or on-disk behaviour; all 54 product recovery cases F00-F53 remain not-executed.
The STRICT-table readability argument relies on SQLite documentation; no pre-3.37.0 library was exercised. The NUL argument alone is measured and sufficient to reject STRICT as the remedy.

UTF-8 is required for lawful hex rows. An inherited carrier created with a UTF-16 encoding (none is known in the reviewed corpus) could not publish carrierFormat 3 and would need a reviewed successor; it fails closed rather than admitting malformed values.

namespace_id keeps a character-length bound counted before any embedded NUL; the attempt-custody record's own minLength/maxLength governs. NUL-containing free text (body, token, request_ref, install_generation_id, namespace_id) is admitted as TEXT: those columns carry no hex grammar and host record admission owns their content.
Enumerated columns rely on SQLite whole-value comparison; they were exercised with BLOB, NUL-suffix, uppercase and integer inputs but not given explicit typeof guards.
The matrix oracle is this author's transcription of the owner patterns (op-/run3:/exec1_ plus lowercase hex lengths, integer and text classes).
Hybrid-frozenddl scenario failures partly cascade from the admitted pre-publication append; they are genuine but not independent.
No reference group, pin verification, planning checker or package verification was run; drift is computed.
The v1 report is not rewritten; its A37-01 grammar and 'never instantiated' statements are superseded here, while its route, publication and drift findings stand.
Not independent acceptance; root integration still requires substantive assessment and an independent review of the corrected bytes.
